meta.name: Assurance Threshold - Three Hunters
meta.blurb: Three hunters choose stag or hare for ten rounds with private sheltered or exposed types; reach 38 to win.

rules: 3 players play {rounds} rounds. At start each player is privately dealt a type: Sheltered or Exposed, each 50% independent ({type_probability_sheltered}). Type is seen only by you and never revealed. Each round every player simultaneously chooses C (hunt stag / invest) or D (hunt hare / don't invest). Let n_C be number who chose C (0-3). Payoffs: If you chose C: you get {payoff_c_all_cooperate} if n_C==3, otherwise {payoff_c_sheltered_partial} if Sheltered and {payoff_c_exposed_partial} if Exposed. If you chose D: you get {payoff_d_lone_defector} if n_C==2 (lone defector), otherwise {payoff_d_other}. After the round each player is told n_C and their own payoff, but not who chose what. Totals accumulate. After {rounds} rounds every player whose cumulative total >= {win_threshold} wins. If one reaches threshold and others do not, that player is sole winner. If multiple reach threshold they share the win. If none reaches threshold the game is a draw. Higher total alone does not win unless it reaches {win_threshold}.

setup.text: Types have been dealt privately. Each player is Sheltered or Exposed with 50% chance.

steps.label: seat 1 chooses
steps.text: Round {round_number} - choose C (hunt stag / invest) or D (hunt hare / don't invest). Your type is private and payoffs depend on n_C.

steps.text: Round {round_number} - choose C (hunt stag / invest) or D (hunt hare / don't invest). Your type is private and payoffs depend on n_C.

steps.text: Round {round_number} - choose C (hunt stag / invest) or D (hunt hare / don't invest). Your type is private and payoffs depend on n_C.

steps.label: score the round

value.calc: (1 if $a1 == 'C' else 0) + (1 if $a2 == 'C' else 0) + (1 if $a3 == 'C' else 0)

payoff_c_all_cooperate if $a1 == 'C' and n_c == 3 else (payoff_c_sheltered_partial if $a1 == 'C' and players[0].player_type == 'Sheltered' else (payoff_c_exposed_partial if $a1 == 'C' else (payoff_d_lone_defector if n_c == 2 else payoff_d_other)))

payoff_c_all_cooperate if $a2 == 'C' and n_c == 3 else (payoff_c_sheltered_partial if $a2 == 'C' and players[1].player_type == 'Sheltered' else (payoff_c_exposed_partial if $a2 == 'C' else (payoff_d_lone_defector if n_c == 2 else payoff_d_other)))

payoff_c_all_cooperate if $a3 == 'C' and n_c == 3 else (payoff_c_sheltered_partial if $a3 == 'C' and players[2].player_type == 'Sheltered' else (payoff_c_exposed_partial if $a3 == 'C' else (payoff_d_lone_defector if n_c == 2 else payoff_d_other)))

steps.text: Round {round_number} revealed: n_C is {n_c}. Totals are Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}.

steps.label: round summary
steps.text: End of round {round_number} of {rounds}: {n_c} players chose C. Cumulative totals - Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}; threshold {win_threshold}.

when.calc: players[0].total_score >= win_threshold and players[1].total_score < win_threshold and players[2].total_score < win_threshold

seat_1_only.text: Seat 1 wins. Final totals: Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}; threshold {win_threshold}, rounds {round_number}/{rounds}, last n_C {n_c}.
seat_1_only.llm: Summarize how the game went over the 10 rounds and why seat 1 is the sole winner: who reached threshold and who did not, the turning point, and what each player's choices and type led to.

when.calc: players[1].total_score >= win_threshold and players[0].total_score < win_threshold and players[2].total_score < win_threshold

seat_2_only.text: Seat 2 wins. Final totals: Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}; threshold {win_threshold}, rounds {round_number}/{rounds}, last n_C {n_c}.
seat_2_only.llm: Summarize how the game went over the 10 rounds and why seat 2 is the sole winner: who reached threshold and who did not, the turning point, and what each player's choices and type led to.

when.calc: players[2].total_score >= win_threshold and players[0].total_score < win_threshold and players[1].total_score < win_threshold

seat_3_only.text: Seat 3 wins. Final totals: Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}; threshold {win_threshold}, rounds {round_number}/{rounds}, last n_C {n_c}.
seat_3_only.llm: Summarize how the game went over the 10 rounds and why seat 3 is the sole winner: who reached threshold and who did not, the turning point, and what each player's choices and type led to.

when.calc: count(p.total_score >= win_threshold for p in players) >= 2

shared_win.text: Shared win. Final totals: Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}; threshold {win_threshold}, rounds {round_number}/{rounds}, last n_C {n_c}. Multiple players reached threshold.
shared_win.llm: Summarize how the game went over the 10 rounds and why this is a shared win: which players reached threshold, the turning point, and what each player's choices and type led to.

when.calc: count(p.total_score >= win_threshold for p in players) == 0

draw.text: Draw. Final totals: Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}; threshold {win_threshold}, rounds {round_number}/{rounds}, last n_C {n_c}. No player reached threshold.
draw.llm: Summarize how the game went over the 10 rounds and why this is a draw with no one reaching threshold: what each player did, the turning point, and how totals stayed below threshold.
